business_scope.primary_industry_name: Direct Online Retail of Portable Battery Generators and Solar Panels

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (Republic of Panama; Ciudad de Panamá registry jurisdiction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law codified system with Anglo-American influence in corporate and commercial law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 1991)
United Kingdom–Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 1993)
Mexico–Panama Reciprocal Investment Protection Agreement (in force 2006)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended by Ley 52 de 2016, Ley 70 de 2019, Ley 158 de 2021) governing AML/CFT; Ley 129 de 18 de marzo de 2020 and Decreto Ejecutivo No. 537 de 26 de julio de 2021 establishing the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF reporting threshold: 10% of capital/voting rights; AML customer-due-diligence threshold: 25%); Ley 32 de 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas; Código de Comercio, Book II; UAF Resoluciones and Aviso series of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) appointing the Panamanian resident agent and incorporation counsel, with notarized signature and legalized certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the beneficial owner's country of residence (and, where applicable, Panama Consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport (or national identity card) of each director, officer, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / issuing government entity of each shareholder's residence state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or Certificate of Good Standing from the origin bank (attesting to account conduct) for the UBO/company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Origin bank (correspondent or regulated depository institution)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential/business address (utility bill or bank statement) of the UBO and directors, notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider / financial institution of the counterparty

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre (official name-clearance certificate) issued by the Registro Público de Panamá
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Público de Panamá (Dirección General de Registro)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not applicable - domestic Panamanian registry certificate (no apostille required for internal use)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly completed UBO declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) and AML/KYC questionnaire per UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporation's legal counsel in Panama (prepared for submission to the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against: (i) the consolidated UN Security Council sanctions list (SC resolutions 1267/1989/2253 and 1373/1988 regimes); (ii) the U.S. OFAC SDN and non-SDN consolidated lists; (iii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list; (iv) Panama's UAF - Lista Oficial de Personas y Entidades (domestic list under Ley 23 de 2015 and UAF resolutions); and (v) Interpol E-series and global PEP databases. Foreign politically exposed persons (PEPs) require enhanced due diligence (EDD), source-of-wealth documentation, and senior management approval; domestic PEPs require EDD per UAF criteria. Automated negative-news and sanctions-reversal screening must be repeated at onboarding and on an ongoing basis by the resident agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sede Electrónica / Servicios en Línea (official online platform: https://www.registropublico.gob.pa; name-search inquiry module for 'Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre')
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be written using the Latin (Roman) alphabet; a name expressed in a foreign language must be accompanied by a Spanish-language translation/rendering at registration; the corporate suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' (or abbreviated 'S.A.') may not itself be translated, and the registered denomination must be distinguishable from all existing docketed names, registered trade names, and reservable marks in the Registro Público database.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO / BANK / TRUST / FIDUCIARIA / FIDEICOMISO (require Superintendencia de Bancos authorization)
SEGUROS / ASEGURADORA / REASEGURO / INSURANCE (require Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros authorization)
VALORES / BOLSA / SECURITIES / FONDO / FUND (require Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores authorization)
CASINO / LOTERÍA / JUEGOS DE AZAR (require Junta de Control de Juegos authorization)
FUNDACIÓN (reserved for private interest foundations under Ley 25 de 1995)
MINISTERIO / GOBIERNO / OFICIAL / NACIONAL / REPÚBLICA DE PANAMÁ (state-organic or misleading official titles)
Names infringing third-party trademarks or existing trade names
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No administrative extension exists for the 30-day name-search certificate; upon expiry a fresh search and reservation fee applies. Upon rejection of a proposed name (identity or confusing-similarity objection), the applicant may: (1) within 5 business days file a 'Recurso de Reconsideración' before the Dirección General of the Registro Público under Ley 38 de 2000, attaching counsel's similarity-analysis opinion and alternative disclaimers; (2) if reconsideration is denied, file a 'Recurso de Apelación' to the superior administrative instance within 5 business days, or challenge before the Contencioso-Administrativo chamber of the Third Superior Tribunal of Justice; and (3) in parallel, reserve 3-5 back-up denominations (numeric/alphabetical variants) to avoid incorporation delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for registry purposes: a S.A. must maintain a resident agent (agente residente) that is a Panamanian attorney, whose office serves as the registered office and service address; no physical premises in Panama are legally required for a pure e-commerce merchant. However, for payment-rail onboarding (Stripe, Affirm BNPL), a verifiable business address, a substantive KYC file, and an address-verification letter from the resident agent will be required; a pure 'virtual office' without agent-supported mail-handling may trigger enhanced AML review.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5-10% probability during the first two operating years): the UAF primarily inspects the corporate-service-provider/agent rather than the merchant entity; DGI (Aviso de Operación) field verifications are initiated principally upon VAT registration, high chargeback/dispute ratios, or suspicious-activity filings. Pre-position the registered-agent file, UBO declarations, source-of-funds documentation, and commercial supply agreements to withstand on-site inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 32 of 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas (as amended by Law 5 of 2015 and Law 4 of 2018), Executive Decreto 363 of 2018 on registered agents, and Regulations of the Registro Público de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública Constitutiva (Articles of Incorporation executed as a notarial public deed) followed by inscription in the Mercantile Register.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; incorporation permitted with nominal capital. Customary structure is USD 10,000 authorized capital divided into 100 registered shares of USD 100 par value each. No escrow account or capital deposit is required under Panamanian law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [CORPORATION NAME], S.A. The incorporator and subscribers, acting under Law 32 of 1927 as amended, hereby approve: (1) the subscription and issuance of the authorized shares to the founding shareholders, reflecting the paid-in subscription recorded in the corporate capital ledger; (2) the adoption of the registered office at the address of the corporation's registered agent in Ciudad de Panamá, and the ratification of the obligation to maintain a resident agent; (3) the appointment of [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer, each to serve until successors are elected; and (4) the authorization of the officers to execute the municipal business license application, tax registration, banking documentation, and e-commerce payment processor agreements. Adopted unanimously and effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Registro de Nombres / authorized registered agent portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name search request through the registered agent or directly at the Public Registry's online platform. Provide the proposed style, e.g., 'Solar Volt Panama, S.A.', plus two fallback names. The Registry will check for identical or confusingly similar names. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days pending incorporation deed presentation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form
Notarized power of attorney or registered agent engagement letter
Passport copies of incorporators/shareholders
Proposed corporate name alternatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity or prohibited terminology, file an administrative reconsideration with the Dirección General de Registro or promptly re-file with a new proposed name under the reserved alternatives.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Notarial Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notarías Públicas de la República de Panamá / licensed Panamanian attorney acting as incorporating notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Escritura Pública Constitutiva before a Panamanian notary. The deed must include the corporate name, general business purpose covering online retail of portable solar generators, authorized share capital, duration, registered agent appointment, board of directors and officers, and any lawful clauses reserving business activities to shareholders. The incorporators or their attorney-in-fact must personally appear or act under power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Approved name reservation certificate
Draft charter and bylaws
Copies of passport/cedula of incorporators and directors
Registered agent acceptance letter (if not named in the charter)
Payment of notarial fees and general stamp tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For notarial omissions, execute a corrective Escritura de Aclaratoria before the same or a new notary and re-present it to the Registry together with the original deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Public Registry Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil y de Micropelículas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the testimonio (certified copy) of the executed public deed at the Public Registry's main office in Panama City or via the electronic inscription system. Include the Registry cover sheet and evidence of payment of the corporate filing fee, registry tariffs, and stamp taxes. The Registry will assign a corporate folio number and issue the official Certificate of Incorporation (Certificado de Persona Jurídica).
required_dossiers: Certified testimonio of the Escritura Pública Constitutiva
Public Registry cover sheet (hoja de entrada)
Fee and stamp tax payment receipts
Registered agent appointment acceptance
Notarized ID copies of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examiner raises a vista fiscal objection, respond within the statutory period with corrective documentation or a written legal brief; if the objection is grounded, obtain a corrective deed and re-file; expedited service is available for urgent registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (RUC) and Municipal Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; and Municipio de Panamá (Alcaldía) – Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, submit the corporate registration form (Solicitud de Registro Único de Contribuyente) at the DGI online taxpayer portal to obtain the RUC number for income tax (territorial basis) and ITBMS (VAT) purposes. Simultaneously file the Aviso de Operación with the Municipality of Panama to obtain the municipal operating license for the registered office/commercial warehouse and pay the proportional municipal tax. For e-commerce retail, no sectoral statutory license is required beyond this municipal permit.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Persona Jurídica (Certificate of Incorporation)
Charter deed copy
RUC registration form signed by legal representative
Municipal Aviso de Operación form
Lease or ownership proof of registered office/warehouse
Copy of DGI tax identification of legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI or municipality queries the application due to inconsistencies in the charter or proof of address, cure by submitting an amended registration form, a clarified corporate resolution, and the corrected lease certificate; appeal any rejection to the administrative fiscal review unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent (for corporate books), Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá regulated banks, and online payment processors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the corporate governance package: issue and deliver share certificates, prepare the stock ledger book, minutes book, and board register, and have the registered agent certify the beneficial ownership register as required by Law 23 of 2015 (AML). Open the corporate bank account with a Panamanian bank or an international gateway supporting SWIFT and link payment rails (Stripe and Affirm) under the RUC certificate; banking due diligence requires identification of ultimate beneficial owners.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent certificate
RUC certificate and municipal Aviso de Operación
Shareholder register and beneficial ownership statement
Directors/officers identification documents
Corporate bank account forms and compliance questionnaire
Business plan and source of funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or processor rejects the onboarding documentation, supplement with notarized English/Spanish translations, apostilled certificates, and an updated beneficial ownership declaration, or re-file with an alternative licensed bank; formal complaints may be lodged with the Superintendencia de Bancos.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Normas y Evaluación Ambiental; municipal Alcaldía for Aviso de Operación
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Municipal (commercial e-commerce retail permit) – no separate industrial manufacturing license applicable

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE), Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I – Exempt/Registration only; low-impact retail warehousing and online sales of portable power equipment do not require a full EIA study; an environmental conformity declaration may be filed if the business opens a battery storage warehouse above 100 m².
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions arise from online retail storage; compliance required with municipal sanitary sewer discharge standards (BOD ≤ 250 mg/L, TSS ≤ 250 mg/L, pH 6-9) for sanitary effluents; spent battery and e-waste handling must follow MiAMBIENTE waste regulations, including segregation, labeling, and disposal through a licensed hazardous waste transporter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá / SINAPROC fire safety inspection certificate for the registered office and any warehouse, including fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and lithium battery storage segregation; structural load certification for palletized solar panel storage under the Municipal Building Department; and workplace safety clearance from Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) covering employee occupational health.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama. Electronic filing and registration portal: Sede Electrónica E-Tax (https://etax.mef.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must first incorporate and register the Panama corporation in the Public Registry (Registro Público) through a licensed attorney and resident agent. Thereafter, file the Registration of Tax Identification (Solicitud de Registro Único de Contribuyentes - RUC) with DGI, submitting certified constitutional documents, valid identity documents of directors and shareholders, the registered office certificate, and a notarized power of attorney for the resident agent. Once the RUC is issued, register for the ITBMS (VAT) and, if applicable, as an employer with the Social Security and Labor authorities. Applicants may use the E-Tax portal or attend the DGI 'Módulo de Atención al Contribuyente' in Panama City. Foreign-source income taxation status must be disclosed using DGI form/formats for territorial income assessment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not employ a check-the-box entity classification election. A Panama S.A. may elect the Small Taxpayer Simplified Regime (SIS) upon registration if annual gross revenue does not exceed USD 36,000, substituting general CIT and ITBMS obligations with a fixed monthly fee. Qualifying companies may elect the Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 41 of 2007 for regional coordination services. With DGI authorization, commonly controlled corporate groups may elect consolidated income tax assessment as an economic group for Panamanian-source income, and taxpayers may elect tax-neutral reorganization treatment for share exchanges and mergers when conditions under the Fiscal Code are met.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS — Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Panama's VAT-equivalent transfer tax on movable goods and services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general registration threshold in USD: any person engaged in taxable transfer of movable goods or provision of services in Panama must register as an ITBMS taxpayer. A simplified SIS threshold exists at USD 36,000 of annual gross revenue, subject to full compliance requirements above this amount.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) under DGI resolutions for large taxpayers and progressively for all businesses. Taxpayers must use an authorized e-invoicing operator or the DGI E-Tax system; invoices must carry a valid DGI-issued digital signature, include a QR code, and be transmitted to DGI in real-time (or within 24 hours) through the Sede Electrónica's API. Retail sales through online payment rails must issue e-invoices or cash-register equivalents with fiscal control numbers; digital stamping occurs at issuance, and DGI requires immediate reconciliation of invoice tax output with ITBMS returns.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for exports of tangible goods (including portable solar generators and solar panels) provided the goods physically leave Panama under a customs export declaration and are sold to a foreign customer outside the Panamanian customs territory. Services are zero-rated when the recipient is resident abroad and the benefit is consumed outside Panama. The seller must maintain an audit trail demonstrating delivery terms (FOB/EXW), title passage, foreign destination, and actual export completion; online e-commerce exports must be evidenced by international courier/Waybill records and payment settlement from foreign bank/card networks. Local sales to Panamanian customers are not zero-rated and remain subject to 7% ITBMS.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única de Exportación (DUS) / Customs Export Declaration
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (master and house) evidencing foreign destination
DGI zero-rated electronic invoice (Factura Electrónica con tasa 0%)
Foreign payment settlement evidence (e.g., Stripe payout statement, SWIFT MT103, card scheme settlement report)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims subject the taxpayer to full ITBMS clawback plus compound interest (statutory annual rate of 12% or proportional monthly surcharge of 1.5%), administrative fines of up to 200% of the tax evaded, closure of establishment, and criminal liability for tax evasion under Panama's Fiscal Code. The DGI can also disqualify the exporter's digital signature and impose monetary sanctions per uninvoiced transaction; wrongful input VAT credits are subject to immediate recovery plus penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No issuing central bank exists in Panama. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the prudential and AML/CFT regulator for banks and financial institutions; Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) acts as the State's fiscal agent and clearing-house bank. The US Dollar is full legal tender under Law 84 of 1941, with the Panamanian balboa circulating only as coins at parity, producing a fully dollarized system without discretionary monetary policy.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is fully dollarized; both current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible without exchange-control authorization or licensing. Profit remittance is unrestricted: dividends, shareholder loans, and capital repatriation may be wired abroad at will. The only friction is taxation: dividends sourced from Panama taxable profits bear a 10% withholding tax generally creditable against the corporate dividend advance; distributions from untaxed foreign-source profits attract a 20% withholding rate. The bank-debit tax (ITBM) of 0.25% applies only to debits, not to inward remittances or credit balances. No approval from any FX authority is required for outward profit transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline for export proceeds. Exporters may freely retain, deploy, or remit USD. The only relevant obligation is documentary: exporters must retain the underlying commercial invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, insurance certificate, and customs declaration for the SBP-mandated five-year record retention period and must make such records available for AML/CFT examination on request.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc., Panamá Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility. Panama does not issue a standalone electronic-money institution (EMI) license; cross-border payment settlement must be executed through SBP-licensed commercial banks or SBP-licensed money remitters (casas de remesa). Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Wise Business, or Dukascopy are not authorized deposit-taking institutions in Panama; use of such accounts as principal treasury vehicles creates unlicensed-money-transmission red flags and severe enhanced due diligence. For the target merchant rails, Stripe does not list Panama as a supported market as of this blueprint; therefore, the Panama-domiciled S.A. cannot receive Stripe or Affirm BNPL settlements directly. The viable structure is a US or EEA merchant-of-record or payment-facilitator intermediary (for example, a US LLC onboarded to Stripe with Affirm as a payment method) that nets settlements to the Panamanian operational account via SWIFT/ACH. This settlement-flow chain must be fully documented to the Panamanian bank to satisfy source-of-funds and business-model review.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person identification of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) is the de facto standard under SBP AML/CFT supervisory practice; all Tier-1 Panamanian banks require at least one physical interview of the UBO or a formally mandated signatory holding a notarized and apostilled power of attorney before account activation. Remote onboarding is exceptional, reserved for low-risk and pre-vetted clients, and accepted at only a minority of banks (for example, Towerbank) using approved digital identity verification. The mandatory documentary package includes: certificate of incorporation and good standing from the Registro Público (apostilled), beneficial-ownership registry certificate, UBO passport and proof of address, professional or banking reference letters, corporate resolutions appointing signatories, and a commercial narrative evidencing the e-commerce operating model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident-owned Panama S.A. with limited local substance operating a cross-border e-commerce platform (portable solar generators and battery packs), triggering enhanced due diligence on UBO, jurisdiction, and foreign-source turnover.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a bankable file: apostilled certificate of incorporation and good standing; beneficial-ownership register certificate; UBO passport plus 3-month proof of address; original banker's reference from a reputable non-Panama bank; two years of personal or corporate tax filings or a sworn source-of-wealth statement; board resolution authorizing account opening and authorized signatories; detailed business plan with supplier contracts, logistics agreements, and marketplace listings; live e-commerce website references; PSP and merchant-of-record agreements; and completed OFAC/EU/UN sanctions and adverse-media screening reports for all officers and shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity pass-through pattern of Stripe/Affirm settlements into a Panamanian account, which may be mischaracterized as unlicensed money transmission or layering, especially with weekly consolidation from a foreign PSP.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a structured settlement-flow file: merchant-of-record or PSP master agreement with Stripe and Affirm BNPL; gateway payout reports with merchant IDs; periodic settlement schedules and transaction-level statistics; refund and chargeback policy; monthly reconciliation certified by a Panamanian licensed CPA; and a written treasury compliance policy prohibiting collection of funds for unrelated third parties or hub-and-spoke pass-through.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound supplier payments to PRC manufacturers of solar panels, inverters, and lithium battery packs, which may trigger trade-based money-laundering or export-control examinations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Compile a per-payment supply-chain file: purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, Panamanian customs declaration, SWIFT copy, beneficiary registration document, and risk-based negative-screen results for the beneficiary against OFAC/EU/UN and denied-party lists. Retain all records for at least five years and present a sanctions-and-due-diligence memo to the bank when requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High receivables volume with low Panamanian taxable income under the territorial system, causing the bank's tax-risk engine to flag potential shell-like behavior or inconsistent profitability.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver provisional income-tax returns filed with the DGI, the tax clearance certificate (Paz y Salvo) where applicable, annual financial statements audited by a Panamanian CPA, inventory and fulfillment contracts showing that goods are delivered outside Panama, and a written territorial-source tax opinion from local counsel to substantiate the taxable margin and the reasonableness of the effective tax burden.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders may inject equity or subordinated shareholder loans from abroad via SWIFT MT103 or correspondent telegraphic transfer without central bank or SBP approval. Recommended SWIFT reference codes: OECD purpose code 'D.3' for equity subscription and 'C.2' for intercompany loans, entered in field 70 with the remitter's bank identified in field 50K/52A. Funds are credited at parity in USD without conversion charge or FX authorization. The bank will require a certified board resolution approving the capital increase or loan and a definitive share-subscription statement; there is no statutory minimum capital, but Tier-1 banks expect initial inflows of USD 25,000–100,000 to evidence funding integrity. Inward amounts are exempt from ITBM debit tax; only subsequent withdrawals will be debited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements include: (1) SWIFT MT103 priority payments for direct USD disbursements to suppliers in the PRC, the US, and other markets; (2) commercial documentary collections (D/P and D/A) for established supplier relationships, routed through the Panamanian bank as presenting bank; (3) irrevocable sight or term letters of credit confirmed by a Hong Kong or PRC advising bank for high-value inventory replenishment of solar panels and battery products; (4) US ACH/Fedwire transfers via the bank's New York correspondent for US logistics, warehousing, and Stripe payout net settlements; (5) Panama local clearing through the Cámara de Compensación operated by Banco Nacional de Panamá for local operating expenses; and (6) CNY-cleared payments through the offshore CNH market or CIPS/SWIFT channel when suppliers require RMB settlement. All outward debits are subject to the 0.25% ITBM debit tax.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with licensed international counterparties under an ISDA master agreement or on-exchange
Deliverable USD/CNH outright forwards executed through the offshore RMB market via a bank with CNH clearing access
USD/CNH cross-currency swaps (or CNY/USD CCS) cleared through an ISDA master and settled via CMU or HKTR facilities
FX options (USD call/CNH put and CNH call/USD put) for contingent procurement exposure, permitted only under a board-approved hedge-only treasury mandate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única / Impuesto Anual de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) / Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the anniversary date of incorporation (e.g., incorporation on 15 March is due by 15 June); payable every year without exception
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late surcharge of 10% per month or fraction of month, capped at 100% of the tax due; no good-standing certificate; after 3 consecutive unpaid years the Registro Público de Panamá may proceed with administrative strike-off and loss of legal personality

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Renta, Form 100)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March of the following calendar year for fiscal-year taxpayers; no administrative extension is available for general corporate filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly surcharge of 10% of the tax due (max 100%) plus annual interest at 10%; additional fines under the Código Fiscal for failure to file; outstanding tax liability survives even if the company is later struck off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Register Confirmation and Update (Ley 23 de 2015)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Resident Agent (custodian of the confidential beneficial-ownership register); not publicly filed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Written annual confirmation executed by the company with its resident agent by 31 January of each year; any share transfer or control change must be reported to the agent within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to USD 10,000 for serious breaches under Law 23 of 2015; inability to open or maintain Panama bank accounts; resignation of resident agent and loss of good standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary General Meeting and Annual Corporate Resolutions (approval of financial statements and officer/director ratification)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records kept internally; minutes filed in the statutory minute book under the resident agent's custody
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year, commonly held within 90 days of fiscal year-end or on the date fixed in the articles of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government penalty; however, absence of annual resolutions invalidates corporate actions, complicates banking/KYC renewals, and is treated as evidence of inactivity supporting strike-off proceedings if the franchise tax is also unpaid

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit for ordinary Sociedades Anónimas. A certified audit (dictamen de Contador Público Autorizado) is required only where annual gross revenue equals or exceeds USD 3,000,000, where the DGI expressly demands audited statements by official notice, or where the entity is regulated, listed, or operates in the public-interest financial sector.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama (NIIF); entities below the audit threshold may maintain simplified records compliant with the Código Fiscal; corporate books must be kept in a language acceptable to the DGI and the Registro Público, generally Spanish with an official translation if otherwise.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Panama maintains a confidential UBO regime under Law 23 of 2015. The resident agent must hold accurate information identifying all natural persons who directly or indirectly own or control 10% or more of the equity or voting rights. Any share transfer, issuance of new shares, or change in control must be communicated to the agent within 30 days. An annual confirmation letter is executed by the board to certify the register is current, and this confirmation is retained solely by the agent for AML/KYC purposes; Panama does not operate a public UBO filing deadline.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Share Transfer Register (Registro de Transferencias de Acciones)
Shareholders' Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de Asambleas de Accionistas)
Board of Directors' Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de Juntas Directivas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 8,000 (only if the USD 3,000,000 gross-revenue threshold is crossed or DGI requires an audit; otherwise USD 0)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial tax regime: foreign-source income is exempt unless derived from Panama-based activity; no statutory tax holiday applies to solar portable power retail, but accelerated depreciation on solar panels and energy-efficient assets may reduce effective rate; small taxpayer regimen available if annual gross income is under the statutory threshold.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 111 (annual corporate income tax return) filed electronically via Panama DGI e-filing system 'Sistema de Declaraciones Electrónicas (SDE)' at dgi.gob.pa.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three (3) months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, no later than March 31 of the next year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Casilla 1 – Ventas brutas de fuente panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenues from Panama-source sales, including domestic deliveries and local pick-up orders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all sales where goods are delivered to a Panama address or title passes in Panama; export orders fulfilled from a Panama warehouse destined abroad must be evaluated for territorial source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Casilla 2 – Ventas brutas de fuente extraterritorial
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cross-border e-commerce sales where the contract is accepted outside Panama, goods ship from a third country, or the buyer is outside Panama and no local operational presence generates the sale.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude from taxable income only when all substantial activity occurs abroad; document marketing/procurement location, order acceptance place, and freight terms (Incoterms).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, including CIF import costs, inventory adjustments, and direct freight.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain vessel/airway bills and customs declarations to substantiate inventory costs; apply a consistent inventory method (FIFO or weighted average).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Casilla 21 – Gastos administrativos y de venta
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses (e-commerce platform fees, payment processor charges, marketing, salaries of Panama staff, logistics).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses attributable to Panama-source income are fully deductible; cross-border service payments must comply with the arm's-length principle and documentary substance rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after applying the 5-year loss carryforward and any applicable ITBM credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carryforward losses only from Panama-source activities; foreign-source losses cannot be netted against Panama-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividends declared during the fiscal year subject to the 5% dividend tax (when paid from taxable income) or the 2% Tax on Dividends from profits of non-taxable foreign income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For dividends paid from exempt foreign-source profits, the 2% special dividend tax may apply; declare in the annual Form 111 and issue Form 113 to shareholders.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a monthly surcharge of 1% of the unpaid tax (capped at 10%), interest at the applicable Banco Nacional rate, and administrative fines of B/.50 to B/.500; failure to file an accurate return or refusal to respond to DGI notices may elevate penalties to 200% of the omitted tax and suspension of the Código de Cuenta (tax ID).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% standard statutory rate on dividends paid from Panama-source taxable income; 10% on dividend distributions sourced from income taxed under alternative/preferential regimes; 2% advance dividend tax applies when distributing exempt foreign-source profits to certain shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident shareholders must deliver to the Panamanian payer a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by their home tax authority (apostilled or legalized, translated to Spanish), complete the beneficial ownership declaration (Form 102), and file the treaty relief application electronically via SDE before the distribution date; the payer must retain the DGI-approved withholding reduction voucher as part of the statutory audit file.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents: statutory WHT 12.5% (treaty-reduced to 5%–10% if applicable); interest paid to non-resident financial institutions: statutory WHT 5%; other debt interest: 12.5% (relevance limited by treaty). Payments must be remitted to DGI within ten (10) days following the month of payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Balboa (B/.) at parity with USD; mandatory Local File and Master File required when the taxpayer's related-party transactions exceed B/. 3,000,000 during the fiscal year, or when gross revenue and total assets both exceed B/. 3,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama implemented Economic Substance Regulations (Law 8 of 2018; Cabinet Resolution 3-2019), requiring companies engaged in intellectual property, distribution, financing, and service activities to maintain physical presence, full-time employees, and board decision-making in Panama. A solar-portable-power online retailer that keeps a Panama warehouse, locally manages inventory, and performs actual commercial functions will satisfy economic substance; a mere letterbox company claiming foreign-source income faces reclassification and penal sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally recharacterizing Panama-source online sales as foreign-source income to exploit the territorial tax exemption, or failing to record Stripe/Affirm payments received into Panamanian bank accounts while filing a zero-tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion under Panama's Tax Procedure Law (Código Fiscal) and Law 5 of 2005: deficiency assessment plus 50% fraud surcharge, criminal fine of B/.10,000–B/.50,000, and imprisonment up to five (5) years for responsible persons.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or permit controlled funds to circulate exclusively abroad are jointly and severally liable for the omitted tax; courts may pierce the corporate veil, attach personal assets, impose travel bans, and issue Interpol red notices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Sociedad Anónima as a bare title board with no office, staff, or operational management in Panama, while routing luminous portable-power e-commerce profitability through related foreign parties to claim a zero effective tax rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of profits as Panama-source income with a 25% corporate tax charge, penalties up to 200% of tax due, cancellation of the company's tax ID, and strike-off from the Public Registry under the economic substance compliance procedure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally responsible for tax debts if the company was managed without substance and in violation of the ESR; civil restitution, denial of exit permits, and disqualification from holding directorships in Panama are primary sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately splitting large purchase payments through Stripe and Affirm to remain below Panama's B/.10,000 mandatory reporting threshold, or ignoring suspicious chargeback patterns that evidence money laundering through the retail front.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of Panama Law 23 of 2015 (AML/CFT) and FATF recommendations: fine from B/.1,000 to B/.1,000,000, mandatory filing of suspicious transaction reports with the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF), and possible suspension of the merchant banking APIs used for payment processing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: AML compliance officers and directors can face criminal prosecution and imprisonment of two (2) to five (5) years; personal bank guarantees, director disqualification, and asset freezing may be ordered even before conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making distributions to non-resident shareholders through offshore accounts without applying the 5% (or 2% for foreign-source profits) dividend withholding tax and without filing the dividend declaration to DGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding tax becomes immediately payable, plus a 10% non-filing surcharge and monthly interest; DGI can block the company's tax account and deny tax clearance certificates until the liability is settled.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly executed or authorized the distribution incur personal liability equal to the withheld tax and related fines; travel restrictions and embargo of personal property can be applied during assessment.
